He said (that) he… He told me (that) he…

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions.

听录音并回答问题。

I'll leave tomorrow.

我明天离开。

What did he say? What did he tell you?

他说了什么？他告诉你什么？

He said (that) he would leave tomorrow. He told me (that) he would leave tomorrow.

他说他明天会离开。他告诉我他明天会离开。

I can't do this Maths problem.

我不会做这道数学题。

What did he say? What did he tell you?

他说了什么？他告诉你什么？

He said (that) he couldn't do this Maths problem. He told me (that) he couldn't do this Maths problem.

他说他不会做这道数学题。他告诉我他不会做这道数学题。

I may return at six o'clock.

我可能六点钟回来。

What did she say? What did she tell you?

她说了什么？她告诉你什么？

She said (that) she might return at six o'clock. She told me (that) she might return at six o'clock.

她说她可能六点钟回来。她告诉我她可能六点钟回来。

Listen and answer the questions

Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

Supplementary practice based on the photographed captions. 依据照片正文补充的练习。

Written A: Answer the questions (reported speech)

Read the report in Lesson 135 again. Then answer these questions. 重读第 135 课的报道，然后回答以下问题。

重读第 135 课的报道，然后回答以下问题。

5 comprehension questions about the Lesson 135 report (Karen Marsh), answered using reported speech.

Written B: What did he/she say?

Answer these questions. 模仿例句回答以下问题。

模仿例句回答以下问题。

4 items; item 1 ('I will be at home at 6.' → She said (that) she would be at home at 6.) is the printed example.

Written C: What did he/she tell you?

Answer these questions. 模仿例句回答以下问题。

模仿例句回答以下问题。

4 items; item 1 ('I will be at home at 6.' → She told me (that) she would be at home at 6.) is the printed example.

02

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

Practice A: Complete the conversations (reported speech)

What did these people say? Complete these short conversations. 用间接引语完成以下对话。

用间接引语完成以下对话。

5 conversations with 10 fill-in items (2 per conversation); item C1 (She said she might not be able to go tomorrow.) is the printed example.

Practice B: About you

Write down three or four things that your family or friends told you yesterday. Make sure you report what was said. 用间接引语形式记录昨天家人或朋友告诉你的三四件事。

Write down three or four things that your family or friends told you yesterday, reporting what was said.

4 open-ended personal writing items: write down one thing that your family or friends told you yesterday, reported in indirect speech. The workbook gives no fixed key; sample answers are suggested.

8 items of direct-to-indirect speech conversion; item 7 is a printed example (shown, not editable); items 1-6 and 8 are editable; answers from the answer key.
